tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The base of every screen: the dark that light is seen against. Never a flat fill on its own; a LightField always lights it.

tokens.name: void-raised
tokens.usage: Solid dark surfaces where glass would be too busy: sheets over sheets, keyboards, the far layer of a stack.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons, warm white. 15:1 on glass over void.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata. 7.6:1 on glass over void.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only.

tokens.name: on-light
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a light fill (a Button lit in any light colour). 6:1 or more on every light colour.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The fill of glass surfaces, over a backdrop blur. Colour from the lights behind shows through it.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected glass, and the off track of toggles and sliders.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The thin lit rim along the top edge of glass, where light catches it.

tokens.name: glass-veil
tokens.usage: Darkens the inside of glass so text stays readable whatever colour glows behind it.

tokens.name: light-firefly
tokens.usage: The firefly's own light, the default light colour. The one primary action, things that are on, the bracelet when it is idle and happy.

tokens.name: light-leaf
tokens.usage: A light colour and a preset (bracelets take any RGB colour). Also success: paired, saved, sent.

tokens.name: light-lagoon
tokens.usage: A light colour and a preset (bracelets take any RGB colour). Also information and connecting.

tokens.name: light-dusk
tokens.usage: A light colour and a preset (bracelets take any RGB colour).

tokens.name: light-bloom
tokens.usage: A light colour and a preset (bracelets take any RGB colour). Received touches from a partner glow in their colour; bloom is the default partner colour.

tokens.name: light-ember
tokens.usage: A light colour and a preset (bracelets take any RGB colour). Also errors and destructive actions.

tokens.name: light-amber
tokens.usage: A light colour and a preset (bracelets take any RGB colour). Also waiting and searching.

families.display: Quicksand, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", system-ui, sans-serif
families.text: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one big moment per screen: onboarding, empty states.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your bracelet should be flashing. Double-tap it to say it's yours.
styles.usage: Running text. Matches iOS Body so Dynamic Type scales it.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Secondary row text, labels in small buttons.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Between stacked lines of text, between orbs.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Between rows, between buttons.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Glass padding, screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between sections. Also the room every glow needs around it.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Around a screen's hero light.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Top of onboarding screens.

tokens.name: radius-soft
tokens.usage: The smallest radius allowed: thumbnails and inner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Glass surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything you tap: buttons, toggles, sliders, pills.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Small lights: status dots, a toggle's knob, the selected orb. In components the colour follows the element's light colour.

tokens.name: glow-md
tokens.usage: A lit button, a slider thumb while dragging.

tokens.name: glow-lg
tokens.usage: Hero light: a received touch, the bracelet orb.

tokens.name: depth
tokens.usage: Glass floating above the light field. Soft and wide.

blur.note: Backdrop and glow blurs. Glass always blurs what is behind it, so colour bleeds through softly instead of showing shapes.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind glass surfaces.

tokens.name: blur-glow
tokens.usage: Softening of glows and halos.

tokens.name: blur-light
tokens.usage: The large light sources of a LightField.

tokens.name: opacity-halo
tokens.usage: Inner halo of a light.

tokens.name: opacity-aura
tokens.usage: Outer aura of a light, where it fades into the void.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

depth.note: Parallax layers. Scrolling moves a layer by its depth; tilting the phone moves it by (1 - depth) times tilt-reach. Depth 1 is the interface plane and does not move with tilt.

tokens.name: depth-far
tokens.usage: The big light sources of a LightField.

tokens.name: depth-back
tokens.usage: Drifting motes and secondary lights.

tokens.name: depth-ui
tokens.usage: Glass, text and controls.

tokens.name: depth-near
tokens.usage: Things that float above the interface: a received touch, a dragged orb.

tokens.name: tilt-reach
tokens.usage: How far a layer at depth 0 travels at full tilt.

haptic.note: The bracelet speaks in light and vibration, so the app does too: every light moment has a haptic. Values name the SwiftUI sensoryFeedback (or Core Haptics pattern) to play.

tokens.name: haptic-tap
tokens.usage: Pressing a button or row.

tokens.name: haptic-select
tokens.usage: Choosing a colour, moving a toggle, each step of a slider.

tokens.name: haptic-confirm
tokens.usage: Paired, saved, sent.

tokens.name: haptic-error
tokens.usage: Something failed.

tokens.name: haptic-touch
tokens.usage: A received touch: the phone plays the touch's own rhythm, the same one the bracelet plays.

tokens.name: haptic-pulse
tokens.usage: Each peak of a pulsing light the person is waiting on (the loader while looking for the bracelet).

duration.note: Shared with the bracelet: a pulse on screen and a breathe on the bracelet use the same period.

tokens.name: duration-tap
tokens.usage: Press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: Toggles, selection, sheets settling.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: One light breath: loader, status dots, the bracelet orb.

tokens.name: duration-float
tokens.usage: The firefly's float.

tokens.name: duration-drift
tokens.usage: One slow drift of a LightField's light sources.

tokens.name: ease-breathe
tokens.usage: Pulses, floats and drifts: symmetric, so loops have no seam.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Things that land: knobs, selection rings. A small overshoot, like a spring.
